Budget Overview 2026 p.55: the City will issue general obligation debt to pay retroactive wages owed to Fire Department members under the contract settled in 2025 (raises back to 2021).
2027 Budget Forecast p.15: $166.0 million one-time borrowing in 2026 to finance one-time retroactive collective bargaining payments.

COFA FY2026 budget summary p.13: new short-term bonds planned to cover back pay of Fire members (2021 to 2025). Council committee chair (Sun-Times, 2025-10-07): total retroactive pay $185 million, paid in 2026. This is not a split of the $98.0M line.

Local 2 contract (Council ordinance O2025-0019993, approved 2025-10-16): six-year deal, raises about 3% a year on average (21% to 25% over the term), $2,500 bonus. The term sheet in the ordinance is a scanned image and was cached but not read ([private source]).

Technical Amendments passed 2025-12-22 (p.L-22 and L-43) moved $104.7M of Scheduled Wage Adjustments from Finance General into the Fire Department lines ($97,974,157 Corporate, $5,303,224 O'Hare, $1,452,422 Midway).
